content.comment_body: Hello, I'm working with [product_name] [version_no]. I previously created a network project on my old computer and it was saved as a [document]. After moving to a new computer and installing the same [product_name] [version_no] (using the original installation USB), I noticed I couldn't select or open [document] files—the extension isn't recognized anymore. Now, new network projects are saved with a different extension, [document]. Renaming the old file to the new extension results in a corrupt file error, so that doesn't help. Does anyone have recommendations? Thanks!

Something seems off. Files with extensions like [document], [document], and [document] are network project files, and which one is used depends on your hardware and software version. - [document]: Used with certain devices and at least [version_no] of the software. - [document]: Used when specific device types are present and at least [version_no]. - [document]: Used when a mix of devices is in the network project and at least one is a newer [version_no]; this requires at least software version [version_no]. So if you have a file with the [document] extension, it was likely created with software version [version_no] or later.

Hello, Thank you for your quick reply. You're correct. On my new computer, I only found [version_no] available online. So that's what I installed. After your advice, I searched again and found [version_no] and installed it. Everything is working now—much appreciated! Thank you!

analysis.insight_summary: Users encountered issues opening network project files with a particular extension after reinstalling the same version of [product_name] on a new computer. This stemmed from discrepancies in file compatibility that depend on both the software version and the extensions. The main cause was that older software versions do not support certain file types, which led to confusion as the user believed the software version was unchanged. Insufficient clarity on file support and version requirements contributed to user frustration.
analysis.user_expectations: Users expect to access all previously made network project files irrespective of their extension, as long as the software version number appears to be the same.
